newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends lower in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends lower in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.12 lower at 42.00 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday as the dollar firmed against major currencies abroad, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open lower on Wednesday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 5.00 percent, compared to the opening at 4.60 percent.
